```html
    <!-- CONFIRMATION MODAL -->
    <div id="confirm-modal" class="hidden fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 p-6 rounded-3xl text-center shadow-2xl max-w-sm w-full">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold font-handwriting text-amber-400 mb-2">Oyundan Çıkılsın mı?</h3>
            <p class="text-slate-300 text-xs mb-6">Mevcut oyun sıfırlanacak ve ana menüye dönülecektir.</p>
            <div class="flex gap-3">
                <button id="cancel-confirm-btn" class="flex-1 bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-white font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm transition">İptal</button>
                <button id="accept-confirm-btn" class="flex-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm transition">Evet, Çık</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- VICTORY MODAL -->
    <div id="victory-modal" class="hidden fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div class="bg-slate-900 border-2 border-amber-500 p-8 rounded-3xl text-center shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="text-6xl text-amber-400 mb-4 animate-bounce">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-crown"></i>
            </div>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold font-handwriting text-white mb-1">Zafer!</h2>
            <p id="winner-announcement" class="text-amber-400 font-semibold text-lg mb-6">1. Oyuncu Bütün Kıtanın Hakimi Oldu!</p>
            
            <div id="final-scores-box" class="bg-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl space-y-2 mb-6 text-left border border-slate-700">
                <!-- Scores summary -->
            </div>

            <button id="restart-after-win-btn" class="w-full bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
                Yeni Oyun Başlat
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CUSTOM TOAST MESSAGE -->
    <div id="toast-message" class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-slate-900 text-white border border-amber-500/50 px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 transform translate-y-20 opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 text-sm font-medium flex items-center space-x-2 pointer-events-none">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info text-amber-400 text-base"></i>
        <span id="toast-text">Uyarı mesajı</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Firebase Imports and Game Engine -->
    <script type="module">
        import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-app.js";
        import { getAuth, signInAnonymously, signInWithCustomToken } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-auth.js";
        import { getFirestore, doc, setDoc, getDoc, onSnapshot } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.6.1/firebase-firestore.js";

        // Global App ID fallback guarantees both players use identical Firestore collections
        const appId = typeof __app_id !== 'undefined' ? __app_id : 'kareli-kitalar-savasi';
        const firebaseConfig = typeof __firebase_config !== 'undefined' ? JSON.parse(__firebase_config) : {
            apiKey: "AIzaSyDummyKeyForFallbackPublicAccess",
            authDomain: "demo-app.firebaseapp.com",
            projectId: "demo-app",
            storageBucket: "demo-app.appspot.com",
            messagingSenderId: "123456789",
            appId: "1:123456789:web:abcdef123456"
        };

        let db = null;
        let auth = null;

        // Session ID uniquely identifies this browser session across devices
        const sessionUid = 'user_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);

        // Async Auth Guard Promise: Resolves only AFTER user authentication completes
        let authUserPromise = null;

        function ensureAuth() {
            if (!authUserPromise) {
                authUserPromise = new Promise(async (resolve) => {
                    try {
                        const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
                        db = getFirestore(app);
                        auth = getAuth(app);

                        let user = auth.currentUser;
                        if (!user) {
                            if (typeof __initial_auth_token !== 'undefined' && __initial_auth_token) {
                                try {
                                    const res = await signInWithCustomToken(auth, __initial_auth_token);
                                    user = res.user;
                                } catch (e) {
                                    const res = await signInAnonymously(auth);
                                    user = res.user;
                                }
                            } else {
                                const res = await signInAnonymously(auth);
                                user = res.user;
                            }
                        }
                        resolve(user);
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.error("Auth init error:", err);
                        resolve(null);
                    }
                });
            }
            return authUserPromise;
        }

        // Initialize auth immediately on script load
        ensureAuth();

        // Color palettes for players
        const PLAYER_COLORS = [
            { name: "Mavi", main: "#2563eb", fill: "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.8)", stroke: "#1d4ed8" },
            { name: "Kırmızı", main: "#dc2626", fill: "rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.8)", stroke: "#b91c1c" },
            { name: "Yeşil", main: "#16a34a", fill: "rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.8)", stroke: "#15803d" },
            { name: "Sarı", main: "#d97706", fill: "rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.8)", stroke: "#b45309" }
        ];

        // Core Game State
        const state = {
            mode: 'local', // 'local' or 'online'
            roomId: '',
            myPlayerIdx: 0, // 0 for Host, 1 for Guest in 2p online
            mySessionUid: sessionUid,
            playerCount: 2,
            players: [],
            currentPlayerIdx: 0,
            diceRoll: 0,
            remainingSteps: 0,
            turnState: 'ROLL_NEEDED', // 'ROLL_NEEDED', 'CLAIMING', 'FINISHED'
            roomStatus: 'WAITING', // 'WAITING', 'PLAYING'
            
            // Map & Large Square Grid Configuration
            gridCols: 40,
            gridRows: 28,
            cellSize: 36, // Large graph paper square size
            grid: [],
            islands: [],
            bridges: [],
            
            // Pan & Zoom Offset
            offsetX: 20,
            offsetY: 20,
            zoom: 1,
            isDragging: false,
            dragStartX: 0,
            dragStartY: 0,
            hasMovedMap: false,

            totalLandTiles: 0,
            unclaimedLandTiles: 0,
            
            audioCtx: null,
            unsubscribeRoomListener: null
        };

        function initAudio() {
            if (!state.audioCtx) {
                state.audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            }
        }

        function playSound(type) {
            if (!state.audioCtx) return;
            try {
                const ctx = state.audioCtx;
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);

                if (type === 'dice') {
                    osc.type = 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(150, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
                } else if (type === 'claim') {
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
                } else if (type === 'autofill') {
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
                } else if (type === 'bridge') {
                    osc.type = 'triangle';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
                } else if (type === 'error') {
                    osc.type = 'sawtooth';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        function generateMap() {
            const cols = state.gridCols;
            const rows = state.gridRows;
            
            state.grid = Array(rows).fill(null).map(() => Array(cols).fill(null));
            state.islands = [];
            state.bridges = [];

            const islandCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 5; 
            const islandSeeds = [];

            let attempts = 0;
            while (islandSeeds.length < islandCount && attempts < 250) {
                attempts++;
                const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (rows - 8)) + 4;
                const c = Math.floor(Math.random() * (cols - 8)) + 4;

                const tooClose = islandSeeds.some(seed => Math.hypot(seed.r - r, seed.c - c) < 6);
                if (!tooClose) {
                    islandSeeds.push({ r, c });
                }
            }

            let totalLand = 0;
            islandSeeds.forEach((seed, idx) => {
                const islandId = idx + 1;
                const islandCells = [];
                const queue = [{ r: seed.r, c: seed.c }];
                
                const targetSize = Math.floor(Math.random() * 25) + 20;

                state.grid[seed.r][seed.c] = {
                    isLand: true,
                    islandId: islandId,
                    owner: null,
                    r: seed.r,
                    c: seed.c
                };
                islandCells.push({ r: seed.r, c: seed.c });

                while (queue.length > 0 && islandCells.length < targetSize) {
                    const current = queue.shift();
                    const dirs = [
                        {r:-1, c:0}, {r:1, c:0}, {r:0, c:-1}, {r:0, c:1}
                    ].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

                    for (let d of dirs) {
                        const nr = current.r + d.r;
                        const nc = current.c + d.c;

                        if (nr >= 2 && nr < rows - 2 && nc >= 2 && nc < cols - 2) {
                            if (!state.grid[nr][nc]) {
                                let neighborOtherIsland = false;
                                for (let dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                                    for (let dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                                        const checkR = nr + dr;
                                        const checkC = nc + dc;
                                        if (state.grid[checkR] && state.grid[checkR][checkC]) {
                                            if (state.grid[checkR][checkC].islandId !== islandId) {
                                                neighborOtherIsland = true;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                if (!neighborOtherIsland && Math.random() < 0.65) {
                                    const cell = {
                                        isLand: true,
                                        islandId: islandId,
                                        owner: null,
                                        r: nr,
                                        c: nc
                                    };
                                    state.grid[nr][nc] = cell;
                                    islandCells.push({ r: nr, c: nc });
                                    queue.push({ r: nr, c: nc });
                                    if (islandCells.length >= targetSize) break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (islandCells.length > 0) {
                    state.islands.push({
                        id: islandId,
                        name: `Ada ${islandId}`,
                        cells: islandCells
                    });
                    totalLand += islandCells.length;
                }
            });

            state.totalLandTiles = totalLand;
            state.unclaimedLandTiles = totalLand;

            // Bridges between closest island points
            for (let i = 0; i < state.islands.length; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < state.islands.length; j++) {
                    const islA = state.islands[i];
                    const islB = state.islands[j];

                    let minDistance = Infinity;
                    let bestPair = null;

                    islA.cells.forEach(cellA => {
                        islB.cells.forEach(cellB => {
                            const dist = Math.hypot(cellA.r - cellB.r, cellA.c - cellB.c);
                            if (dist < minDistance) {
                                minDistance = dist;
                                bestPair = {
                                    fromIsland: islA.id,
                                    toIsland: islB.id,
                                    cellA: { r: cellA.r, c: cellA.c },
                                    cellB: { r: cellB.r, c: cellB.c },
                                    dist: dist
                                };
                            }
                        });
                    });

                    if (bestPair && minDistance <= 12) {
                        state.bridges.push(bestPair);
                    }
                }
            }

            addLog(`Yeni büyük harita oluşturuldu! ${state.islands.length} ada ve ${state.totalLandTiles} kare var.`);
        }

        const canvas = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        function centerMap() {
            const container = canvas.parentElement;
            if (!container) return;
            const containerW = container.clientWidth;
            const containerH = container.clientHeight;

            const mapW = state.gridCols * state.cellSize * state.zoom;
            const mapH = state.gridRows * state.cellSize * state.zoom;

            state.offsetX = Math.max(20, (containerW - mapW) / 2);
            state.offsetY = Math.max(20, (containerH - mapH) / 2);
            drawMap();
        }

        function resizeCanvas() {
            const container = canvas.parentElement;
            if (!container) return;
            canvas.width = container.clientWidth;
            canvas.height = container.clientHeight;

            drawMap();
        }

        function drawMap() {
            if (!ctx) return;
            const cs = state.cellSize;

            // 1. Clear background paper fill
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbf7ee';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            ctx.save();
            // Apply Pan Translation & Zoom
            ctx.translate(state.offsetX, state.offsetY);
            ctx.scale(state.zoom, state.zoom);

            const mapWidth = state.gridCols * cs;
            const mapHeight = state.gridRows * cs;

            // 2. Draw Large Graph Paper Grid Lines
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbf7ee';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, mapWidth, mapHeight);

            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(203, 224, 240, 0.85)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            for (let x = 0; x <= mapWidth; x += cs) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
                ctx.lineTo(x, mapHeight);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            for (let y = 0; y <= mapHeight; y += cs) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                ctx.lineTo(mapWidth, y);
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Notebook Red Margin Line
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fca5a5';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cs * 1.5, 0);
            ctx.lineTo(cs * 1.5, mapHeight);
            ctx.stroke();

            // 3. Draw Bridges
            state.bridges.forEach(bridge => {
                const cellA = state.grid[bridge.cellA.r][bridge.cellA.c];
                const cellB = state.grid[bridge.cellB.r][bridge.cellB.c];

                const x1 = (bridge.cellA.c + 0.5) * cs;
                const y1 = (bridge.cellA.r + 0.5) * cs;
                const x2 = (bridge.cellB.c + 0.5) * cs;
                const y2 = (bridge.cellB.r + 0.5) * cs;

                ctx.save();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
                
                if (cellA.owner && cellB.owner && cellA.owner !== cellB.owner) {
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6)';
                } else {
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.7)';
                }
                
                ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
                ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.restore();

                ctx.fillStyle = '#d97706';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x1, y1, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.arc(x2, y2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });

            // 4. Draw Land Tiles with Dark Graphite Grid Lines ONLY for island tiles
            for (let r = 0; r < state.gridRows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < state.gridCols; c++) {
                    const cell = state.grid[r][c];
                    if (cell && cell.isLand) {
                        const x = c * cs;
                        const y = r * cs;

                        if (cell.owner !== null) {
                            const player = state.players.find(p => p.id === cell.owner);
                            const colorObj = PLAYER_COLORS[player ? player.colorIdx : 0];

                            ctx.fillStyle = colorObj.fill;
                            ctx.fillRect(x, y, cs, cs);

                            // Inner pen slash line
                            ctx.strokeStyle = colorObj.stroke;
                            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(x + 4, y + cs - 4);
                            ctx.lineTo(x + cs - 4, y + 4);
                            ctx.stroke();

                        } else {
                            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.55)';
                            ctx.fillRect(x, y, cs, cs);
                        }

                        // Dark Slate/Graphite Grid Lines ONLY for island tiles
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.85)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                        ctx.strokeRect(x, y, cs, cs);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 5. Highlight Valid Clickable Moves for Active Player
            const isMyTurn = (state.mode === 'local') || (state.myPlayerIdx === state.currentPlayerIdx);
            if (state.turnState === 'CLAIMING' && state.remainingSteps > 0 && isMyTurn) {
                const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
                if (currentPlayer) {
                    const validMoves = getValidMovesForPlayer(currentPlayer.id);

                    validMoves.forEach(move => {
                        const x = move.c * cs;
                        const y = move.r * cs;

                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.6)';
                        ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, cs - 2, cs - 2);

                        ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                        ctx.strokeRect(x + 1, y + 1, cs - 2, cs - 2);

                        if (move.isBridgeTarget) {
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#b45309';
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(x + cs / 2, y + cs / 2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            ctx.fill();
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        const canvasContainer = document.querySelector('.canvas-container');

        if (canvasContainer) {
            canvasContainer.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                state.isDragging = true;
                state.dragStartX = e.clientX - state.offsetX;
                state.dragStartY = e.clientY - state.offsetY;
                state.hasMovedMap = false;
            });

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                if (!state.isDragging) return;
                const newX = e.clientX - state.dragStartX;
                const newY = e.clientY - state.dragStartY;

                if (Math.hypot(newX - state.offsetX, newY - state.offsetY) > 6) {
                    state.hasMovedMap = true;
                }

                state.offsetX = newX;
                state.offsetY = newY;
                drawMap();
            });

            window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                state.isDragging = false;
            });

            // Touch Drag Logic for Mobile
            canvasContainer.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                if (e.touches.length === 1) {
                    state.isDragging = true;
                    state.dragStartX = e.touches[0].clientX - state.offsetX;
                    state.dragStartY = e.touches[0].clientY - state.offsetY;
                    state.hasMovedMap = false;
                }
            });

            canvasContainer.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                if (!state.isDragging || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
                const newX = e.touches[0].clientX - state.dragStartX;
                const newY = e.touches[0].clientY - state.dragStartY;

                if (Math.hypot(newX - state.offsetX, newY - state.offsetY) > 6) {
                    state.hasMovedMap = true;
                }

                state.offsetX = newX;
                state.offsetY = newY;
                drawMap();
            });

            canvasContainer.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                state.isDragging = false;
            });
        }

        // Zoom Controls
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.zoom = Math.min(state.zoom + 0.15, 1.8);
            drawMap();
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.zoom = Math.max(state.zoom - 0.15, 0.6);
            drawMap();
        });

        document.getElementById('reset-view-btn').addEventListener('click', centerMap);

        function getValidMovesForPlayer(playerId) {
            const valid = [];
            const playerCells = [];

            for (let r = 0; r < state.gridRows; r++) {
                for (let c = 0; c < state.gridCols; c++) {
                    if (state.grid[r][c] && state.grid[r][c].owner === playerId) {
                        playerCells.push({ r, c });
                    }
                }
            }

            if (playerCells.length === 0) {
                for (let r = 0; r < state.gridRows; r++) {
                    for (let c = 0; c < state.gridCols; c++) {
                        if (state.grid[r][c] && state.grid[r][c].isLand && state.grid[r][c].owner === null) {
                            valid.push({ r, c, isBridgeTarget: false });
                        }
                    }
                }
                return valid;
            }

            const visited = new Set();
            playerCells.forEach(pc => {
                const neighbors = [
                    { r: pc.r - 1, c: pc.c },
                    { r: pc.r + 1, c: pc.c },
                    { r: pc.r, c: pc.c - 1 },
                    { r: pc.r, c: pc.c + 1 }
                ];

                neighbors.forEach(n => {
                    if (n.r >= 0 && n.r < state.gridRows && n.c >= 0 && n.c < state.gridCols) {
                        const cell = state.grid[n.r][n.c];
                        if (cell && cell.isLand && cell.owner === null) {
                            const key = `${n.r},${n.c}`;
                            if (!visited.has(key)) {
                                visited.add(key);
                                valid.push({ r: n.r, c: n.c, isBridgeTarget: false });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
            });

            // Island Crossing via Bridges
            state.bridges.forEach(bridge => {
                const cellA = state.grid[bridge.cellA.r][bridge.cellA.c];
                const cellB = state.grid[bridge.cellB.r][bridge.cellB.c];

                if (cellA.owner === playerId && cellB.owner === null) {
                    const key = `${bridge.cellB.r},${bridge.cellB.c}`;
                    if (!visited.has(key)) {
                        visited.add(key);
                        valid.push({ r: bridge.cellB.r, c: bridge.cellB.c, isBridgeTarget: true });
                    }
                }

                if (cellB.owner === playerId && cellA.owner === null) {
                    const key = `${bridge.cellA.r},${bridge.cellA.c}`;
                    if (!visited.has(key)) {
                        visited.add(key);
                        valid.push({ r: bridge.cellA.r, c: bridge.cellA.c, isBridgeTarget: true });
                    }
                }
            });

            return valid;
        }

        function autoFillIsolatedTerritories() {
            let totalAutoFilled = 0;
            let filledInLoop = 0;

            do {
                filledInLoop = 0;
                const activePlayerIds = state.players.map(p => p.id);
                const reachabilityMap = new Map();

                for (let r = 0; r < state.gridRows; r++) {
                    for (let c = 0; c < state.gridCols; c++) {
                        if (state.grid[r][c] && state.grid[r][c].isLand && state.grid[r][c].owner === null) {
                            reachabilityMap.set(`${r},${c}`, new Set());
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (reachabilityMap.size === 0) break;

                activePlayerIds.forEach(pId => {
                    const validMoves = getValidMovesForPlayer(pId);
                    const queue = [...validMoves];
                    const visitedForPlayer = new Set();

                    queue.forEach(m => visitedForPlayer.add(`${m.r},${m.c}`));

                    while (queue.length > 0) {
                        const curr = queue.shift();
                        const key = `${curr.r},${curr.c}`;

                        if (reachabilityMap.has(key)) {
                            reachabilityMap.get(key).add(pId);
                        }

                        const neighbors = [
                            { r: curr.r - 1, c: curr.c },
                            { r: curr.r + 1, c: curr.c },
                            { r: curr.r, c: curr.c - 1 },
                            { r: curr.r, c: curr.c + 1 }
                        ];

                        neighbors.forEach(n => {
                            if (n.r >= 0 && n.r < state.gridRows && n.c >= 0 && n.c < state.gridCols) {
                                const nCell = state.grid[n.r][n.c];
                                if (nCell && nCell.isLand && nCell.owner === null) {
                                    const nKey = `${n.r},${n.c}`;
                                    if (!visitedForPlayer.has(nKey)) {
                                        visitedForPlayer.add(nKey);
                                        queue.push({ r: n.r, c: n.c });
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        });

                        state.bridges.forEach(bridge => {
                            if (bridge.cellA.r === curr.r && bridge.cellA.c === curr.c) {
                                const bCell = state.grid[bridge.cellB.r][bridge.cellB.c];
                                if (bCell.owner === null) {
                                    const bKey = `${bridge.cellB.r},${bridge.cellB.c}`;
                                    if (!visitedForPlayer.has(bKey)) {
                                        visitedForPlayer.add(bKey);
                                        queue.push({ r: bridge.cellB.r, c: bridge.cellB.c });
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            if (bridge.cellB.r === curr.r && bridge.cellB.c === curr.c) {
                                const aCell = state.grid[bridge.cellA.r][bridge.cellA.c];
                                if (aCell.owner === null) {
                                    const aKey = `${bridge.cellA.r},${bridge.cellA.c}`;
                                    if (!visitedForPlayer.has(aKey)) {
                                        visitedForPlayer.add(aKey);
                                        queue.push({ r: bridge.cellA.r, c: bridge.cellA.c });
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });

                reachabilityMap.forEach((reachingPlayers, tileKey) => {
                    if (reachingPlayers.size === 1) {
                        const solePlayerId = Array.from(reachingPlayers)[0];
                        const [rStr, cStr] = tileKey.split(',');
                        const r = parseInt(rStr);
                        const c = parseInt(cStr);

                        const cell = state.grid[r][c];
                        if (cell && cell.owner === null) {
                            cell.owner = solePlayerId;
                            
                            const ownerObj = state.players.find(p => p.id === solePlayerId);
                            if (ownerObj) ownerObj.score += 1;

                            state.unclaimedLandTiles -= 1;
                            filledInLoop++;
                        }
                    }
                });

                totalAutoFilled += filledInLoop;

            } while (filledInLoop > 0);

            if (totalAutoFilled > 0) {
                playSound('autofill');
                const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
                showToast(`🔒 ${currentPlayer.name} etrafı kapalı ${totalAutoFilled} kareyi otomatik fethetti!`);
                addLog(`🔒 ${currentPlayer.name} etrafı kapalı ${totalAutoFilled} kareyi otomatik fethetti.`);
            }

            return totalAutoFilled;
        }

        canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            initAudio();
            if (state.hasMovedMap) return;

            // Strict Online Turn Guard
            if (state.mode === 'online' && state.myPlayerIdx !== state.currentPlayerIdx) {
                playSound('error');
                showToast("Sıra sizde değil! Diğer oyuncunun hamlesini bekleyin.");
                return;
            }

            if (state.turnState !== 'CLAIMING' || state.remainingSteps <= 0) return;

            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            
            // Critical Scale Normalization Fix
            const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
            const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;

            const clickX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
            const clickY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;

            // Map translation and zoom transform
            const mapX = (clickX - state.offsetX) / state.zoom;
            const mapY = (clickY - state.offsetY) / state.zoom;

            const c = Math.floor(mapX / state.cellSize);
            const r = Math.floor(mapY / state.cellSize);

            if (r < 0 || r >= state.gridRows || c < 0 || c >= state.gridCols) return;

            const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
            const validMoves = getValidMovesForPlayer(currentPlayer.id);

            const isSelectedMove = validMoves.find(m => m.r === r && m.c === c);

            if (isSelectedMove) {
                const cell = state.grid[r][c];
                cell.owner = currentPlayer.id;
                currentPlayer.score += 1;
                state.unclaimedLandTiles -= 1;
                state.remainingSteps -= 1;

                if (isSelectedMove.isBridgeTarget) {
                    playSound('bridge');
                    showToast(`${currentPlayer.name} köprüyü geçerek Ada ${cell.islandId}'e adım attı!`);
                    addLog(`${currentPlayer.name} Ada ${cell.islandId}'e köprü kurdu!`);
                } else {
                    playSound('claim');
                }

                autoFillIsolatedTerritories();

                updateUI();
                drawMap();

                if (checkVictoryCondition()) {
                    if (state.mode === 'online') syncOnlineRoomState();
                    return;
                }

                if (state.remainingSteps <= 0) {
                    state.turnState = 'FINISHED';
                    addLog(`${currentPlayer.name} turunu tamamladı.`);
                    document.getElementById('end-turn-btn').disabled = false;
                    document.getElementById('end-turn-btn').className = "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition";
                }

                if (state.mode === 'online') {
                    syncOnlineRoomState();
                }
            } else {
                playSound('error');
                showToast("Burayı fethedemezsiniz! Komşu karelerden veya boş ada köprülerinden ilerleyin.");
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('roll-dice-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            initAudio();

            // Strict Online Turn Guard
            if (state.mode === 'online' && state.myPlayerIdx !== state.currentPlayerIdx) {
                playSound('error');
                showToast("Sıra sizde değil! Diğer oyuncunun hamlesini bekleyin.");
                return;
            }

            if (state.turnState !== 'ROLL_NEEDED') return;

            const diceModal = document.getElementById('dice-modal');
            const diceBox = document.getElementById('dice-3d-box');
            const diceResultText = document.getElementById('dice-result-text');

            diceModal.classList.remove('hidden');
            diceBox.classList.add('animate-roll');
            playSound('dice');

            const roll = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;

            setTimeout(() => {
                diceBox.classList.remove('animate-roll');
                
                const diceIcons = ['fa-dice-one', 'fa-dice-two', 'fa-dice-three', 'fa-dice-four', 'fa-dice-five', 'fa-dice-six'];
                diceBox.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${diceIcons[roll - 1]} text-amber-500"></i>`;
                diceResultText.innerText = `${roll} GELDİ!`;

                setTimeout(() => {
                    diceModal.classList.add('hidden');
                    
                    state.diceRoll = roll;
                    state.remainingSteps = roll;
                    state.turnState = 'CLAIMING';

                    const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
                    addLog(`${currentPlayer.name} zarda ${roll} attı!`);

                    const possibleMoves = getValidMovesForPlayer(currentPlayer.id);
                    if (possibleMoves.length === 0) {
                        showToast(`${currentPlayer.name} için hamle yapacak boş yer kalmadı! Pas geçiliyor.`);
                        addLog(`${currentPlayer.name} hamle yapamadı ve pas geçti.`);
                        
                        if (!checkVictoryCondition()) {
                            advanceToNextPlayer();
                        }
                    } else {
                        updateUI();
                        drawMap();
                    }

                    if (state.mode === 'online') {
                        syncOnlineRoomState();
                    }
                }, 800);
            }, 700);
        });

        function advanceToNextPlayer() {
            state.currentPlayerIdx = (state.currentPlayerIdx + 1) % state.players.length;
            state.diceRoll = 0;
            state.remainingSteps = 0;
            state.turnState = 'ROLL_NEEDED';

            document.getElementById('end-turn-btn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('end-turn-btn').className = "bg-slate-300 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed font-semibold px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition";

            updateUI();
            drawMap();

            const nextPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
            showToast(`Sıra ${nextPlayer.name} kullanıcısında!`);

            if (state.mode === 'online') {
                syncOnlineRoomState();
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('end-turn-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (state.mode === 'online' && state.myPlayerIdx !== state.currentPlayerIdx) return;
            advanceToNextPlayer();
        });

        function checkVictoryCondition() {
            let totalPossibleMovesAllPlayers = 0;
            state.players.forEach(p => {
                totalPossibleMovesAllPlayers += getValidMovesForPlayer(p.id).length;
            });

            if (state.unclaimedLandTiles <= 0 || totalPossibleMovesAllPlayers === 0) {
                const sortedPlayers = [...state.players].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
                const topScore = sortedPlayers[0].score;
                const winners = sortedPlayers.filter(p => p.score === topScore);

                const announcement = document.getElementById('winner-announcement');
                if (winners.length === 1) {
                    announcement.innerText = `🏆 ${winners[0].name} Toplam ${winners[0].score} Kare İle Kıtaların Hakimi Oldu!`;
                } else {
                    const winnerNames = winners.map(w => w.name).join(' ve ');
                    announcement.innerText = `🤝 Berabere! ${winnerNames} ${topScore} Kare İle Zaferi Paylaştı!`;
                }
                
                const scoresBox = document.getElementById('final-scores-box');
                const medals = ['🥇', '🥈', '🥉', '4.'];
                
                scoresBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="text-xs uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2 border-b border-slate-700 pb-1">Fetih Sıralaması</div>
                    ${sortedPlayers.map((p, rank) => {
                        const c = PLAYER_COLORS[p.colorIdx];
                        const pct = state.totalLandTiles > 0 ? Math.round((p.score / state.totalLandTiles) * 100) : 0;
                        return `
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-sm text-slate-200 py-1.5 border-b border-slate-800">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                                    <span class="text-base">${medals[rank] || ''}</span>
                                    <span class="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-white" style="background-color:${c.main}"></span>
                                    <span class="font-bold">${p.name}</span>
                                </div>
                                <span class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-400">${p.score} Kare (${pct}%)</span>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    }).join('')}
                `;

                document.getElementById('victory-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
                addLog(`OYUN BİTTİ! Haritadaki tüm fethedilebilir topraklar tamamlandı.`);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        async function createOnlineRoom() {
            const user = await ensureAuth();
            if (!user || !db || !auth.currentUser) {
                showToast("Çevrimiçi servis bağlanamadı. Sayfayı yenileyip tekrar deneyin.");
                return;
            }

            const hostName = document.getElementById('online-player-name').value.trim() || '1. Oyuncu';
            state.roomId = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();
            state.myPlayerIdx = 0; // Host is Player 1
            state.playerCount = 2;
            state.roomStatus = 'WAITING';

            state.players = [{
                id: 'p_1',
                name: hostName,
                colorIdx: 0,
                score: 0,
                uid: state.mySessionUid
            }];

            generateMap();

            const roomRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', appId, 'public', 'data', 'rooms', state.roomId);

            const serializedGrid = state.grid.map(row => row.map(cell => cell ? {
                isLand: !!cell.isLand,
                islandId: cell.islandId || 0,
                owner: cell.owner !== undefined ? cell.owner : null,
                r: cell.r,
                c: cell.c
            } : null));

            try {
                await setDoc(roomRef, {
                    roomId: state.roomId,
                    players: state.players,
                    maxPlayers: 2,
                    roomStatus: 'WAITING',
                    currentPlayerIdx: 0,
                    turnState: 'ROLL_NEEDED',
                    diceRoll: 0,
                    remainingSteps: 0,
                    gridCols: state.gridCols,
                    gridRows: state.gridRows,
                    grid: JSON.stringify(serializedGrid),
                    islands: state.islands,
                    bridges: state.bridges,
                    totalLandTiles: state.totalLandTiles,
                    unclaimedLandTiles: state.unclaimedLandTiles,
                    updatedAt: Date.now()
                });

                document.getElementById('waiting-room-code').innerText = state.roomId;
                document.getElementById('room-code-display').innerText = state.roomId;
                document.getElementById('room-badge').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('waiting-modal').classList.remove('hidden');

                listenToOnlineRoom(state.roomId);
            } catch(e) {
                console.error("Room creation error:", e);
                showToast("Oda oluşturulurken bir hata oluştu: " + (e.message || "İzin hatası"));
            }
        }

        async function joinOnlineRoom() {
            showToast("Odaya bağlanılıyor...");
            const user = await ensureAuth();
            if (!user || !db || !auth.currentUser) {
                showToast("Çevrimiçi servis bağlanamadı. Sayfayı yenileyip tekrar deneyin.");
                return;
            }

            const codeInput = document.getElementById('join-room-input');
            const code = codeInput ? codeInput.value.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
            const joinerName = document.getElementById('online-player-name').value.trim() || '2. Oyuncu';

            if (!code || code.length < 3) {
                showToast("Lütfen geçerli bir Oda Kodu girin!");
                return;
            }

            const roomRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', appId, 'public', 'data', 'rooms', code);

            try {
                const snap = await getDoc(roomRef);
                if (snap.exists()) {
                    const data = snap.data();
                    const existingPlayers = data.players || [];
                    
                    let existingIdx = existingPlayers.findIndex(p => p.uid === state.mySessionUid);
                    
                    if (existingIdx !== -1) {
                        state.myPlayerIdx = existingIdx;
                    } else if (existingPlayers.length >= (data.maxPlayers || 2)) {
                        showToast("Bu oda zaten dolu!");
                        return;
                    } else {
                        state.myPlayerIdx = existingPlayers.length;
                    }

                    state.roomId = code;
                    
                    let updatedPlayers = [...existingPlayers];
                    if (existingIdx === -1) {
                        const newPlayer = {
                            id: `p_${state.myPlayerIdx + 1}`,
                            name: joinerName,
                            colorIdx: state.myPlayerIdx,
                            score: 0,
                            uid: state.mySessionUid
                        };
                        updatedPlayers.push(newPlayer);
                    }

                    await setDoc(roomRef, {
                        players: updatedPlayers,
                        roomStatus: 'PLAYING',
                        updatedAt: Date.now()
                    }, { merge: true });

                    document.getElementById('room-code-display').innerText = code;
                    document.getElementById('room-badge').classList.remove('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('setup-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.remove('hidden');

                    listenToOnlineRoom(code);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        resizeCanvas();
                        centerMap();
                        updateUI();
                    }, 100);

                    showToast(`${code} Odasına başarıyla katıldınız!`);
                } else {
                    showToast("Oda bulunamadı! Kodu kontrol edip tekrar deneyin.");
                }
            } catch(e) {
                console.error("Join room error:", e);
                showToast("Odaya katılırken bir hata oluştu: " + (e.message || "Kod veya ağ hatası"));
            }
        }

        async function syncOnlineRoomState() {
            if (!state.roomId) return;
            const user = await ensureAuth();
            if (!user || !db || !auth.currentUser) return;

            const roomRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', appId, 'public', 'data', 'rooms', state.roomId);
            
            const serializedGrid = state.grid.map(row => row.map(cell => cell ? {
                isLand: !!cell.isLand,
                islandId: cell.islandId || 0,
                owner: cell.owner !== undefined ? cell.owner : null,
                r: cell.r,
                c: cell.c
            } : null));

            try {
                await setDoc(roomRef, {
                    players: state.players,
                    currentPlayerIdx: state.currentPlayerIdx,
                    turnState: state.turnState,
                    diceRoll: state.diceRoll,
                    remainingSteps: state.remainingSteps,
                    gridCols: state.gridCols,
                    gridRows: state.gridRows,
                    grid: JSON.stringify(serializedGrid),
                    islands: state.islands,
                    bridges: state.bridges,
                    totalLandTiles: state.totalLandTiles,
                    unclaimedLandTiles: state.unclaimedLandTiles,
                    roomStatus: state.roomStatus,
                    updatedAt: Date.now()
                }, { merge: true });
            } catch (err) {
                console.log("Room sync notice:", err);
            }
        }

        async function listenToOnlineRoom(roomId) {
            if (!roomId) return;
            const user = await ensureAuth();
            if (!user || !db || !auth.currentUser) return;

            if (state.unsubscribeRoomListener) {
                state.unsubscribeRoomListener();
                state.unsubscribeRoomListener = null;
            }

            const roomRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', appId, 'public', 'data', 'rooms', roomId);
            
            state.unsubscribeRoomListener = onSnapshot(roomRef, (snapshot) => {
                if (snapshot.exists()) {
                    const data = snapshot.data();
                    
                    state.players = data.players || state.players;

                    const myIdx = state.players.findIndex(p => p.uid === state.mySessionUid);
                    if (myIdx !== -1) {
                        state.myPlayerIdx = myIdx;
                    }

                    if (data.currentPlayerIdx !== undefined) state.currentPlayerIdx = data.currentPlayerIdx;
                    if (data.turnState !== undefined) state.turnState = data.turnState;
                    if (data.diceRoll !== undefined) state.diceRoll = data.diceRoll;
                    if (data.remainingSteps !== undefined) state.remainingSteps = data.remainingSteps;
                    if (data.unclaimedLandTiles !== undefined) state.unclaimedLandTiles = data.unclaimedLandTiles;
                    if (data.roomStatus !== undefined) state.roomStatus = data.roomStatus;

                    if (data.islands) state.islands = data.islands;
                    if (data.bridges) state.bridges = data.bridges;
                    if (data.gridCols) state.gridCols = data.gridCols;
                    if (data.gridRows) state.gridRows = data.gridRows;

                    if (data.grid) {
                        try {
                            state.grid = JSON.parse(data.grid);
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }

                    if (state.roomStatus === 'PLAYING') {
                        document.getElementById('waiting-modal').classList.add('hidden');
                        document.getElementById('setup-screen').classList.add('hidden');
                        document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                        
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            resizeCanvas();
                            drawMap();
                            updateUI();
                        }, 50);
                    }

                    updateUI();
                    drawMap();
                }
            }, (error) => console.log("Snapshot listener error:", error));
        }

        function updateUI() {
            if (state.players.length === 0) return;

            const currentPlayer = state.players[state.currentPlayerIdx];
            const colorObj = PLAYER_COLORS[currentPlayer.colorIdx];

            document.getElementById('active-player-name').innerText = currentPlayer.name;
            document.getElementById('active-player-color-dot').style.backgroundColor = colorObj.main;

            const isMyTurn = (state.mode === 'local') || (state.myPlayerIdx === state.currentPlayerIdx);

            const roleBadge = document.getElementById('my-role-badge');
            if (state.mode === 'online') {
                roleBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
                if (isMyTurn) {
                    roleBadge.innerText = "Sizin Sıranız!";
                    roleBadge.className = "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs";
                } else {
                    roleBadge.innerText = "Rakibin Sırası Bekleniyor...";
                    roleBadge.className = "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-500/30 text-xs";
                }
            } else {
                roleBadge.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            document.getElementById('remaining-steps').innerText = state.remainingSteps;
            document.getElementById('total-tiles-count').innerText = `${state.unclaimedLandTiles} / ${state.totalLandTiles} Boş`;

            const rollBtn = document.getElementById('roll-dice-btn');
            if (state.turnState === 'ROLL_NEEDED' && isMyTurn) {
                rollBtn.disabled = false;
                rollBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            } else {
                rollBtn.disabled = true;
                rollBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            }

            const lbList = document.getElementById('leaderboard-list');
            lbList.innerHTML = state.players.map((p, idx) => {
                const c = PLAYER_COLORS[p.colorIdx];
                const isActive = idx === state.currentPlayerIdx;
                const isMe = state.mode === 'online' && idx === state.myPlayerIdx;
                const pct = Math.round((p.score / (state.totalLandTiles || 1)) * 100);

                return `
                    <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl transition border ${isActive ? 'bg-slate-700/90 border-amber-500 shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-700/60'}">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                                <span class="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-white" style="background-color: ${c.main}"></span>
                                <span class="font-bold text-sm ${isActive ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-200'}">${p.name} ${isMe ? '(Siz)' : ''}</span>
                            </div>
                            <span class="font-mono font-extrabold text-amber-400 text-sm">${p.score} Kare</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="w-full bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-700">
                            <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${pct}%; background-color: ${c.main}"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.player-count-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.player-count-btn').forEach(b => {
                    b.classList.remove('active-player-count', 'text-amber-400', 'border-amber-500');
                });
                btn.classList.add('active-player-count', 'text-amber-400', 'border-amber-500');
                state.playerCount = parseInt(btn.dataset.count);
                renderPlayerInputs();
            });
        });

        function renderPlayerInputs() {
            const container = document.getElementById('player-inputs-container');
            if (!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            for (let i = 0; i < state.playerCount; i++) {
                const color = PLAYER_COLORS[i];
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = "flex items-center space-x-3 bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700";
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow" style="background-color: ${color.main}"></span>
                    <input type="text" value="${i+1}. Oyuncu" class="player-name-input flex-1 bg-transparent text-white font-semibold text-sm focus:outline-none" data-idx="${i}">
                `;
                container.appendChild(div);
            }
        }
        renderPlayerInputs();

        document.getElementById('start-local-game-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const nameInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.player-name-input');
            state.players = [];

            nameInputs.forEach((input, i) => {
                state.players.push({
                    id: `p_${i + 1}`,
                    name: input.value.trim() || `${i + 1}. Oyuncu`,
                    colorIdx: i,
                    score: 0
                });
            });

            state.currentPlayerIdx = 0;
            state.turnState = 'ROLL_NEEDED';

            generateMap();

            document.getElementById('setup-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.remove('hidden');

            setTimeout(() => {
                resizeCanvas();
                centerMap();
                updateUI();
            }, 100);
        });

        document.getElementById('mode-local-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.mode = 'local';
            document.getElementById('mode-local-btn').className = "flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow";
            document.getElementById('mode-online-btn').className = "flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition text-slate-400 hover:text-white";
            document.getElementById('local-setup-section').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('online-setup-section').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('room-badge').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('mode-online-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.mode = 'online';
            document.getElementById('mode-online-btn').className = "flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow";
            document.getElementById('mode-local-btn').className = "flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition text-slate-400 hover:text-white";
            document.getElementById('local-setup-section').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('online-setup-section').classList.remove('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('create-online-room-btn').addEventListener('click', createOnlineRoom);
        document.getElementById('join-online-room-btn').addEventListener('click', joinOnlineRoom);

        document.getElementById('join-room-input').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                joinOnlineRoom();
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('cancel-waiting-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('waiting-modal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('room-badge').classList.add('hidden');
            if (state.unsubscribeRoomListener) state.unsubscribeRoomListener();
        });

        function addLog(msg) {
            const logBox = document.getElementById('game-log');
            if (!logBox) return;
            const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            const item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = "py-0.5 border-b border-slate-700/50 flex space-x-1.5";
            item.innerHTML = `<span class="text-slate-500">[${time}]</span><span>${msg}</span>`;
            logBox.prepend(item);
        }

        function showToast(text) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast-message');
            if (!toast) return;
            document.getElementById('toast-text').innerText = text;
            toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
            setTimeout(() => { toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0'); }, 3000);
        }

        function copyToClipboard(text) {
            const temp = document.createElement('input');
            document.body.appendChild(temp);
            temp.value = text;
            temp.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            document.body.removeChild(temp);
            showToast("Oda kodu panoya kopyalandı!");
        }

        document.getElementById('copy-room-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            copyToClipboard(document.getElementById('room-code-display').innerText);
        });

        document.getElementById('copy-waiting-code-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            copyToClipboard(document.getElementById('waiting-room-code').innerText);
        });

        document.getElementById('restart-after-win-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('victory-modal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('setup-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('reset-game-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('cancel-confirm-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        document.getElementById('accept-confirm-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('setup-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (!document.getElementById('game-screen').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                resizeCanvas();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

### Updates Made:
- **Game Completion Criteria:** The victory system now checks if `unclaimedLandTiles` reaches zero OR if all players are blocked from making any valid moves.
- **Winner & Leaderboard Modal:** Calculates percentage of map control, displays medal ranks (🥇, 🥈, 🥉), and supports tie games gracefully if two or more players conquer equal amounts of land.

```html
    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <!-- Google Fonts: Caveat (Notebook feel) and Inter -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script>
        tailwind.config = {
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    fontFamily: {
                        handwriting: ['Caveat', 'cursive'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'],

    </script>
    <style>
        @keyframes rollDice {
            0% { transform: rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) scale(1); }
            30% { transform: rotateX(360deg) rotateY(180deg) scale(1.2); }
            70% { transform: rotateX(720deg) rotateY(540deg) scale(1.2); }
            100% { transform: rotateX(1080deg) rotateY(720deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: rollDice 0.7s ease-out forwards;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .canvas-container {
            touch-action: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-900 text-slate-800 font-sans min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between overflow-x-hidden select-none">

    <!-- Top Header Navigation -->
    <header class="bg-slate-800 text-white border-b border-slate-700 px-4 py-3 shadow-md">
        <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex justify-between items-center">
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <div class="bg-amber-500 text-slate-900 p-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xl shadow">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-map"></i>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h1 class="text-xl font-bold tracking-wide font-handwriting text-2xl text-amber-400">Kareli Kıtalar Savaşı</h1>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Online & Yerel Kare Fethetme Stratejisi</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div id="room-badge" class="hidden flex items-center space-x-2 bg-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-600">
                <span class="text-xs text-slate-300">Oda Kodu:</span>
                <span id="room-code-display" class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 tracking-wider">----</span>
                <button id="copy-room-btn" title="Kodu Kopyala" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition ml-1">
                    <i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- MAIN CONTAINER -->
    <main class="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-2 sm:p-4 flex flex-col gap-4">

        <!-- LOBBY / SETUP SCREEN -->
        <div id="setup-screen" class="max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-700 my-auto">
            <div class="text-center mb-6">
                <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold font-handwriting text-amber-400 mb-2">Oyuna Başla</h2>
                <p class="text-slate-300 text-sm">Büyük kareli kağıt üzerinde adaları fethetmek için modu ve oyuncu adınızı seçin.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- Game Mode Tabs -->
            <div class="flex bg-slate-900/60 p-1 rounded-xl mb-6 border border-slate-700">
                <button id="mode-local-btn" class="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-users mr-2"></i>Yerel Oyun (Aynı Ekran)
                </button>
                <button id="mode-online-btn" class="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-globe mr-2"></i>Çevrimiçi Oda (Canlı)
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Player Setup Options -->
            <div class="space-y-5">
                <!-- Local Setup Section -->
                <div id="local-setup-section" class="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400 mb-2">Oyuncu Sayısı</label>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                            <button class="player-count-btn bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 border border-slate-600 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg active-player-count text-amber-400 border-amber-500" data-count="2">2 Oyuncu</button>
                            <button class="player-count-btn bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 border border-slate-600 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg" data-count="3">3 Oyuncu</button>
                            <button class="player-count-btn bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 border border-slate-600 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg" data-count="4">4 Oyuncu</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div id="player-inputs-container" class="space-y-3 pt-2">
                        <!-- Dynamic inputs -->
                    </div>

                    <button id="start-local-game-btn" class="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-bold py-4 rounded-xl text-lg shadow-lg hover:shadow-amber-500/20 transition transform active:scale-95">
                        Haritayı Oluştur ve Başla <i class="fa-solid fa-dice-d6 ml-2"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Online Setup Section -->
                <div id="online-setup-section" class="hidden space-y-4">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400 mb-1">Oyuncu Adınız</label>
                        <input type="text" id="online-player-name" value="Oyuncu" class="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500">
                    </div>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                        <!-- Create Room Box -->
                        <div class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 flex flex-col justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-bold text-amber-400 text-base mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus-circle mr-2"></i>Oda Oluştur</h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-4">Yeni bir harita oluştur ve arkadaşını davet et.</p>
                            </div>
                            <button id="create-online-room-btn" class="w-full bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold py-3 rounded-xl transition shadow">
                                Yeni Oda Kur
                            </button>

                        <!-- Join Room Box -->
                        <div class="bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 flex flex-col justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-bold text-emerald-400 text-base mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-right-to-bracket mr-2"></i>Odaya Katıl</h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-3">Arkadaşından aldığın oda kodunu gir.</p>
                                <input type="text" id="join-room-input" placeholder="Oda Kodu (Örn: AB12)" class="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-center font-mono text-base uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 mb-3">
                            </div>
                            <button id="join-online-room-btn" class="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl transition shadow">
```
